title: Small Business Electricity Supply Bundle Discount on Commercial Natural Gas Supply Renewal Prices
content:
**Term.** A bundle discount is taken off the Commercial Natural Gas Supply offer price, on a renewal accepted after rollover, for businesses that also take Beacon Ridge Small Business Electricity Supply at the same premise:

- when that Small Business Electricity Supply agreement is active on a term of at least 24 months, the discount is $0.0120 per therm;
- when it is active on a shorter term, month-to-month included, the discount is $0.0060 per therm;
- when no Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on that premise is active, there is no bundle discount.

The discount is a per-therm amount taken off the offer price once. The status and the term in months are read from the Small Business Electricity Supply agreement record for the gas site's premise.

## Discount by electricity holding

| Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on the same premise | Term in months | Bundle discount per therm |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 24 or more | $0.0120 |
| Active | 1 to 23 | $0.0060 |
| Active | 0 (month-to-month) | $0.0060 |
| Not active, or none on the premise | Any | None |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A warehouse's gas site shares its premise with an active Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on a 36-month term: $0.0120 per therm.
- A café's electricity agreement on the same premise is active on a 12-month term: $0.0060 per therm.
- A school's electricity agreement on the premise is enrollment pending: not active, so no bundle discount.
